observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlamp/headlight assembly lying on the ground.
The lens has a clear cover with internal reflectors and an amber/orange side indicator section.
A text/logo on the lens appears to read something like “PURE…D…” but the exact brand/model is not clearly readable.

claims.claim: All Hyundai and kia genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used...
claims.evidence: Only one headlamp is shown; no proof of Hyundai/Kia compatibility, genuineness, or whether it is new vs fairly used.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (year/model/side: left vs right) for the buyer’s car; headlamps are often model-specific.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the headlamp label/sticker (part number) and a clear shot showing whether it is LH or RH, plus the car model/year it fits.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used headlamp with unknown fitment (worst case for buyer).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in the photo (cracked lens, moisture inside, broken adjuster tabs, missing bulbs/holders).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the lens edges and reflector surfaces, and a short video showing it powered on (beam + indicator).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed fully functional/complete (worst case).

risks.risk: “Genuine” claim may be incorrect (could be aftermarket/refurbished).
risks.proof: Ask for the part number and brand marking on the housing/label, and a photo of any OEM marking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed genuine (worst case).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the headlamp housing label/part number (and any OEM marking).
Confirm LH or RH (left/right) with a photo from the mounting side.
Send a short video test: headlamp ON (main beam) and indicator ON.
State the exact car model/year it fits (Hyundai/Kia) and show the part number match.
response.reason: The photo shows a headlamp, but the key pricing drivers (exact model/year fitment, left/right, and condition/functionality) are not verifiable from the single image and the seller’s text.
